rows.text: The party heads the statement of 20 October 2004 'Statement issued by Shri L.K. Advani President At a press conference in New Delhi on October 20, 2004'.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: In the statement he says he is pleased to be 'at my first press conference after assuming the office of the President of the Bharatiya Janata Party two days ago', the party having entrusted the responsibility to him after Shri M. Venkaiah Naidu stepped down, and refers to 'The meeting of the office-bearers, which took place day before yesterday'.
